Leah (CEO): Quick follow-up thread from today's Q&A. We pulled several consistent signals about deals. Post one short signal or the next action you need.

Victor (Sales): Field signal: closed two retail pilots because they liked our transparent per-call costing + easy Dedicated staging. Lost a HealthTech pilot — procurement flagged BYOK + deeper audit logs as blockers.

Noor (Product Ops): Can we prioritize a tiny set of deliverables we can promise Sales within 14 days? My vote: BYOK scoping doc, audit-readiness one-pager, migration playbook template.

Grace (Solutions): From implementation side, a short migration playbook + an "expected cost delta" example helps close deals. Example line we share: "Typical token-cost reduction 25-40% when enabling prefix cache + batching for seqs <1024."

Felipe (Eng): Engineering notes: BYOK split: customer-managed cloud KMS vs on-prem HSM. If HSM-backed wrapping required, work scope jumps. Also audit logs: retention + immutable write path matter. Need a decision: tiered retention (30/90/365) or single enterprise option?

Rahul (Security): From compliance: Fin/Health customers often require HSM-backed key wrapping OR FIPS 140-2 KMS. Also expect tamper-evident audit trails and proof of deletion. Can Product list target retention windows and whether cross-region replication is allowed?

Emma (CS): CS asks: one-page "what to hand procurement/legal" PDF + two anonymized SOC2 artifacts (redacted). Also ask for 1-2 "talking points" reps can use about performance/cost wins.

Grace (Solutions): Quick playbook snippet to include in docs:

```
Migration playbook (summary):
- Pre-checks: model size, peak qps, regulatory region
- Staging: spin Dedicated pool, mirror 10% traffic
- Tune: enable batching, prefix caching, measure p95
- Rollout: weighted 5/20/60/100
- Post: report cost delta and SLOs
```

Victor (Sales): Can we include a sample cost table for reps? even 2 rows: "default" vs "optimized" would be great.

announce-bot: New ticket created: TKT-7120 "BYOK + audit-retention scoping + sales kit artifacts" assigned to Felipe. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/TKT-7120

Felipe (Eng): I'll pick up TKT-7120. Request: Rahul / Security, please post exact HSM/KMS acceptance criteria here so I can estimate.

Rahul (Security): Will post a short checklist to the ticket (FIPS level, audit event schema, key rotation policy).

Noor (Product Ops): Owners: Felipe -> TKT-7120 scope, Noor -> migration playbook doc, Emma -> procurement one-pager + SOC2 examples. Please post rough E2E ETA by next Wed.

Leah (CEO): Thanks. Also ask Sales to draft 3 one-line "why we won" statements (latency, cost, migration), drop them here. We'll review tickets in roadmap sync. :rocket:
